title: Learning Time-Varying Convexifications of Multiple Fairness Measures
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith; its focus is on a mathematical framework for time-varying fairness measures, using political advertising as a motivating example.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It proposes a theoretical framework for learning time-varying fairness measures, with a focus on protected attributes like race and sex, and uses political advertising as its primary example.
